name: Advent Health Executive Data Voice Agent
description: Voice/text assistant for Advent Health executives (CIO, CMO, CFO, Chief Clinical Officers) to query hospital operations and financial data quickly — e.g., readmission rates, bed capacity, staffing, revenue, AR aging, and patient cohort summaries for targeted interventions. Prioritize accuracy, brevity, and privacy-compliant responses backed only by tool outputs.
prompt: You are an Advent Health executive data assistant. Be concise, factual, and avoid speculation. Never fabricate data — only report information returned from tools. If a requested metric or timeframe is ambiguous, ask one concise clarifying question. Always respect patient privacy and PHI rules: do not reveal full patient identifiers or sensitive details unless the user is explicitly authorized (assume voice session is executive-level authorized only for aggregated and de-identified cohort outputs). Use tools only when needed. Keep replies short (1–4 sentences), include the key metric value, trend (up/down/flat) vs prior period when available, and next recommended action if metric is outside target thresholds. Respond in English.

tools.name: noop
tools.description: No-op tool used to persist scenario/context. Returns a simple acknowledgement.

tools.name: get_operational_metrics
tools.description: Retrieve operational KPIs (e.g., 30-day readmit rate, ED LOS, OR utilization) for one or more facilities over a specified date range. Returns metric values, prior-period comparison, and thresholds.

metric_codes.description: List of metric codes (e.g., READMIT_30, ED_LOS_HRS, OR_UTIL)

dimension_id.description: Facility ID or department based on group_by

tools.name: get_financial_report
tools.description: Return financial summaries (net revenue, operating margin, AR aging buckets) for specified business units, date ranges, and contract lines. Includes top-line P&L and a breakdown by product line or payor when requested.

tools.name: get_patient_cohort
tools.description: Return a de-identified patient cohort list and summary statistics for a query (e.g., COPD 30-day readmits) filtered by facility(s), date window, and inclusion criteria. Returns limited PHI (hashed MRN or pseudonym), counts, ZIP3, admission/discharge dates, and readmit counts.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of patient records to return

tools.name: get_bed_capacity_and_staffing
tools.description: Return current and historical bed capacity, staffed beds, occupancy %, and nursing FTE vs required by shift for specified facility or unit and date/time window.

scenarios.name: Q3 Cardiology 30-day Readmit Review Across Three Facilities
scenarios.text: Stakeholder: CMO requests 30-day readmit rates for Cardiology (service line) across three facilities for Q3 2025 (2025-07-01 to 2025-09-30). Facilities: AH-ORL-001 (Orlando Regional), AH-NAP-002 (Naples General), AH-MEM-003 (Memorial South). Target threshold: 10% readmit_30. Expected tool call get_operational_metrics with metric_codes ['READMIT_30'], facility_ids ['AH-ORL-001','AH-NAP-002','AH-MEM-003'], start_date '2025-07-01', end_date '2025-09-30', group_by 'facility'. Expected results (consistent with tool sample): AH-ORL-001 = 12.4% (prior 11.2%), AH-NAP-002 = 9.1% (prior 9.6%), AH-MEM-003 = 10.8% (prior 10.0%). Recommended immediate action: investigate AH-ORL-001 cardiology discharge processes and care transitions; consider targeted follow-up calls within 7 days. Include facility names, facility IDs, metric values, and whether each is above the 10% threshold.

scenarios.name: November MTD Finance Snapshot for AH-WEST
scenarios.text: Stakeholder: CFO requests Month-to-Date (MTD) financial summary for AH-WEST for November 2025 (2025-11-01 to 2025-11-30). Business unit: AH-WEST. Request includes net revenue, operating margin %, and AR aging buckets. Also ask for product-line breakdown for Cardiac Cath (PROC-CH-001), Inpatient COPD bundle (IP-COPD-002), and ED Observation (ED-OBS-01). Expected tool call get_financial_report with business_unit_ids ['AH-WEST'], start_date '2025-11-01', end_date '2025-11-30', granularity 'MTD', include_ar_aging true, product_lines ['PROC-CH-001','IP-COPD-002','ED-OBS-01']. Expected results (aligned to sample): net_revenue $14,235,000; operating_margin_percent 6.2%; AR aging 0-30: $4,200,000; 31-60: $1,850,000; 61-90: $890,000; 91+: $1,270,000. Product line revenues and avg contract rates included in response. Action: flag 31-60 bucket rising vs prior month and recommend AR focus on payor X contracts where denial rate exceeded 6%.

scenarios.name: COPD 30-day Readmit Cohort for Targeted Outreach
scenarios.text: Stakeholder: Chief Clinical Officer requests a de-identified cohort of COPD patients with 30-day readmissions across facilities AH-ORL-001 and AH-NAP-002 for index admissions between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-31. Cohort code: COPD_READMIT_30. Expected tool call get_patient_cohort with cohort_code 'COPD_READMIT_30', facility_ids ['AH-ORL-001','AH-NAP-002'], start_date '2025-09-01', end_date '2025-10-31', max_rows 50. Expected result: total_count 42, median_age 68, percent_female 54.8, common_zip3 '327'. Include example pseudo_mrn list entries (HX-7f3a9, HX-8c2d1, HX-5b6e4) with ages, zip3s, index admission and discharge dates, readmit_count_30d, and primary_drg codes (DRG-190, DRG-189). Recommended action: enroll top 25% high-readmit_count patients into a 7-day post-discharge telefollow and coordinate home health for those in zip3 '327'.

scenarios.name: Morning Capacity and Nursing Shortfall Snapshot for AH-ORL-001
scenarios.text: Stakeholder: Chief Nursing Officer requests a snapshot 'as of' 2025-12-05T07:00:00-05:00 for AH-ORL-001 units MedSurg-3A and ICU-1 to assess staffed beds, occupancy, and nursing FTE shortfalls per shift. Expected tool call get_bed_capacity_and_staffing with facility_id 'AH-ORL-001', unit_ids ['MedSurg-3A','ICU-1'], as_of_datetime '2025-12-05T07:00:00-05:00'. Expected response (aligned to sample): MedSurg-3A bed_count 28, staffed_beds 26, occupancy 96.2%, nursing_fte_on_shift 9.0, required 11.0 (shortfall 2.0). ICU-1 staffed 12/12, occupancy 100%, no shortfall. Recommended immediate action: escalate staffing float pool to cover 2.0 FTE for MedSurg-3A and delay nonurgent discharges until afternoon if staffing not filled.
